_doc: Format of content/signup-provider-test.json, which tools/test-signup-live.mjs writes only after a live test on a TEST list in which every case passed. build.py --with-signup is refused without that file, and refuses this example. It also refuses a record in which any case's pass is not the value true, whose harness is not tools/test-signup-live.mjs, or whose digest (SHA-256 over provider, list, date, tested_by, function_sha256 and cases; src/optional/signup/record.mjs) does not match. Do not write or edit the record by hand: run the harness (docs/email-signup.md).
list: Name of the test list or newsletter used (never the live list)
tested_by: Name of the person who ran the test and answered its questions

invalid_address.observed: e.g. 'not-an-address: HTTP 400, outcome invalid, 0 provider calls; nwpt-signup-test-1767225600000@example.invalid: HTTP 400, outcome rejected, 1 provider call'

confirmation_email.observed: e.g. 'operator: email arrived; its link confirmed the address'

repeat_address.observed: e.g. 'HTTP 400, outcome rejected, 1 provider call; operator: address listed once and still confirmed; the message is true for a confirmed subscriber'

unsubscribe.observed: e.g. 'operator: the unsubscribe link worked and the provider shows the address as unsubscribed'

provider_outage.observed: e.g. 'connection refused: 502 unconfirmed; provider 503: 502 unconfirmed; redirect: 502 unconfirmed, not followed; no answer: 504 unconfirmed after 8.0 s; wrong key (real provider): 503 refused'

digest: SHA-256 written by the harness and recomputed by the build
